{{Quote|Watch your left! They went down the the cell bay!|Stormtrooper towards his squad|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
This '''stormtrooper''' was stationed onboard the Death Star during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Stationed onboard the Death Star, he was part of a squad that were assigned to go up to investigate a ruse at the [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]]. As one of his fellow stormtroopers sliced the doors open and was shot to death by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], he informed the others that the rebels were heading down the cell bay, knowing there was no where out for them to run.
